notes: Um prompt por plano. Cada plano anima o par Start (frame A) -> End (frame B) da Fase 1.

Dialogos: apenas os planos 2 e 7 tem fala on-camera, conforme o video de referencia. Os planos 1, 3, 4, 5 e 6 sao B-roll sem fala (dialogue = null). Se o roteiro final tiver mais falas, me passe as linhas e eu encaixo.
Falas conhecidas do video anterior: plano 2 = 'Hi! I'm your music producer'; plano 7 = 'So, shall we create something together?'. Ambas em ingles americano.

Modelo: kling3_0 para planos contemplativos (camera calma), seedance_2_0 para os com energia/corte. Prompts Seedance idealmente traduzidos para chines na entrega final (regra do framework) - aqui estao em ingles para iteracao.
Em toda geracao passe o character sheet / as 2 fotos de retrato como --image junto do --start-image. O --start-image e o still A aprovado; o --end-image (Kling) ou frame final e o still B aprovado.
Sound design sempre fisico e especifico, nunca musical. Todo prompt Seedance termina com 'No music.'

shared_locks.identity: Same man as the still references, face identical on every frame - early-30s, warm light-brown mixed complexion, closely buzzed near-shaved hair with a natural hairline, thick dark eyebrows, dark brown eyes, straight nose, full lips, a neat mustache linking into a narrow chin-strap beard with a small soul patch, lean face, calm direct presence. No morphing of face, hairline or beard shape at any point.
shared_locks.wardrobe: Plain white crew-neck cotton t-shirt with no print, an open black denim trucker jacket, black trousers. No watch, no rings, no necklace, no hat.
shared_locks.environment: Intimate home music studio: solid walnut desk with warm grain; back wall is a wooden skyline acoustic diffuser of staggered timber blocks; centred ultrawide monitor showing a DAW timeline with coloured audio waveforms; two black nearfield studio monitors on foam isolation pads flanking the screen; slim silver audio interface in front; lower shelf with a synthesizer, a groovebox and a rack unit; large-diaphragm condenser microphone on a black articulated boom arm with a round pop filter at frame right; closed-back headphones resting on the desk edge.
shared_locks.light: Low-key motivated lighting: soft warm key from camera-left at about 45 degrees; subtle cool rim light separating him from the dark diffuser wall; deep controlled shadows; no blown highlights and no bright window; practical LEDs on the gear glowing warm.
shared_locks.look: Full-frame 35mm cinematography, warm filmic colour with teal-leaning shadows and amber highlights, gentle fine film grain, faint halation on speculars, protected slightly-lifted blacks, midtone priority on skin, shallow natural depth of field. Photoreal, shot on prime lenses. Inspired by the work of award-winning directors.

The camera starts on a medium-close portrait, three-quarter angle, and dollies gently straight in over the full shot until it rests on a tight close-up of just his face and the tops of his shoulders. 85mm lens, no shake, constant slow speed, no rotation - a clean controlled move. He holds still and keeps his eyes locked into the lens the whole time, calm and confident. The only motion from him: one slow natural blink and the faint rise and fall of a quiet breath. No head turn, no expression change. Same man as the references, face identical on every frame of the move: closely buzzed near-shaved hair with a natural hairline, thick dark eyebrows, dark brown eyes, straight nose, full lips, a neat mustache linking into a narrow chin-strap beard with a small soul patch, lean face, warm light-brown complexion - same bone structure, hairline and beard shape throughout. He wears a plain white crew-neck t-shirt and an open black denim trucker jacket. Behind him the wooden skyline diffuser wall and gear stay fully soft, dissolving further into warm bokeh as the camera closes in. Low-key motivated light: soft warm key from camera-left with a clear warm catchlight in each eye, subtle cool rim on the cheekbone and ear, deep controlled shadow on the far side.
